subject: Re: HealthSys technical onboarding - VPC & IAM deep-dive (scheduling)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthsys.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HealthSys technical onboarding — VPC/network/IAM deep-dive

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the productive discovery call last week. Per our conversation, the next step is a 60- to 90-minute technical deep-dive to align on VPC connectivity options, on-prem networking requirements, and IAM patterns for your regulated workloads. We want to make sure we have the right folks from your side: procurement for contract timing, security for data flow/retention constraints, and the platform engineers who will run the VPC peering / VPN.

Can you confirm availability for a 90-minute slot in the week of Jan 12? Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jan 13, 10:30–12:00
- Wed Jan 14, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Jan 15, 08:00–09:30

If none work, please suggest two alternatives. I’ve cc’d Dylan (SE) so he can prepare a runbook and lining up examples of our network diagrams. I’ll attach a short pre-read checklist to help your security/procurement folks.

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & objectives (5–10m)
2) Deployment modes: hosted vs dedicated vs private (15m)
3) Network topology options (VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN, on-prem) (25m)
4) IAM & key management patterns (15m)
5) Rollout & reqs: audit logs, data residency, canary plan (15m)
6) Next steps & owners (10m)

Attachments: redwood-vpc-preflight.pdf (checklist), pre-demo-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — happy to book once you confirm attendees and a time.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129

Hey Neha — thanks for the outline.

We should include procurement (Priya, cc’d) and our security lead (Lina, cc’d). Of your proposed slots the only one that looks doable right now is Wed Jan 14 13:00–14:30 PST. Priya flagged that procurement may join for the first 20 minutes for procurement timeline and then drop.

Quick notes from our infra team:
- We prefer a VPN + private peers setup but need to understand traffic patterns and port requirements.
- Lina will want to review log retention and audit trail capabilities; please have any SOC2 or audit artifacts handy.

I’ll hold the Wed 13:00 slot tentatively. Please send an invite and attach the pre-read.

—Samir

Dylan — can you: 
- Draft the runbook and share the network diagram (PNG) for their team to pre-validate?

- Attach pointer to our SOC2 report (or link) for Lina?

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthSys technical onboarding — VPC/network/IAM deep-dive

Thanks — sharing the first-pass materials below. I attached a simplified network diagram and a short firewall/ports matrix. Short notes here:
- For initial verification we typically ask for 100 Mbps steady baseline for dedicated/private models, with burst allowances for spikes.
- Common ports: 443 outbound to our endpoints; if using peering, ensure route exchange on the relevant prefixes.
- For on-prem VPN, we support both IKEv2/SAML and client-managed tunnels; will cover key rotation and KMS options.

I’ve uploaded: healthsys-network-diagram.png, redwood-vpc-preflight.pdf, and a pointer to SOC2: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2 (public stub).

I’ll prepare the runbook and send final invite from our calendar (90 minutes) to avoid rushing the IAM section.

—Dylan
